text:
alex_m: Quick sync — product wants to ship the dependency-aware routing flag next week. it toggles routing priority between redwood-default and customer-preferred endpoints and requires a small routing-service change + cache priming. need rollout plan that handles Dedicated tenants and avoids flag oscillation.

nina: TL;DR: propose a three-phase rollout: shadow -> staged A/B -> full. include explicit dependency gates for cache priming + routing service.

ram: +1. For Dedicated customers we should require an opt-in window and a staged capacity reservation. otherwise we risk SLA spikes.

liz: callout: overlapping flags are the real risk. we should attach a dependency matrix to the flag metadata so launch playbooks can auto-block conflicting flags.

qa_sam: experiments & acceptance: define a quality delta threshold (e.g. <= 0.5% rerank divergence, latency P95 change <= 25ms) + synthetic prompts set. we should run shadow traffic for 48h before any user-facing AB.

alex_m: good. propose this rollout sequence: 1) internal shadow (100% shadow) 12h, smoke tests pass 2) external shadow (1% real traffic) 48h 3) staged A/B: 5%/95% for 24h, then 20%/80% 24h 4) 100% with monitoring & kill-switch.

nina: add a regional ramp: start in us-west, then eu-west, then apac. Ramp windows need to align with oncall handover times. also schedule a hotfix window in case we need to revert during EU work hours.

ram: Dedicated tenants:require manual opt-in + capacity hold for first 72h. add routing-tier fallback to an older model variant if latency or error-rate breaches thresholds.

liz: include an anti-oscillation policy: once a flag moves downstream (A/B -> 100%), disallow immediate flip back for 6h unless manual emergency. prevents rapid toggles during noisy telemetry.

qa_sam: checks to automate before each step:
```
- smoke: healthcheck endpoints, kv-cache hit rate >= 95% for primed routes
- perf: median latency delta <= 10ms, P95 <= configured SLO
- quality: synthetic prompt pass rate >= 99% against baseline
```

alex_m: ops actions: create a per-rollout runbook with these pieces: dependency list, capacity reservation, kill-switch command, telemetry dashboard link, and the rollback owner. I'll draft.

nina: customer comms: notify Dedicated customers with opt-in link + expected window. surface known incompatibilities and suggested mitigations. attach sample curl for opting in.

ram: for AB metrics, metric owners: latency (eng-sre), error-rate (runtime), quality/regression (applied-ml). need the owners listed in the runbook.

liz: config-wise: add `dependencies: ["cache-priming", "routing-service-v2"]` to the flag definition, and `lockout_hours: 6` for anti-oscillation. also add a `conflicts` field.

qa_sam: small test: run a tenant-exclusion list to ensure customers with custom routing are not auto-enrolled. i can add tests to telemetry harness.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: routing-service-v2 -> canary cluster at 4001234580. Automated smoke will post results.

alex_m: perfect. next steps: nina to own customer comms, ram to coordinate Dedicated capacity, liz to update flag metadata, qa_sam to wire tests, i'll draft runbook and share by EOD. :thumbsup:

nina: on it. sending a draft to #customer-comm in 2h.

ram: ping me when the canary is healthy, i'll approve Dedicated opt-ins.

liz: will update the feature-flag schema and add a precondition check in the flag service.

qa_sam: will run synthetic suite and post results to the runbook doc.

alex_m: thanks all — keeping this thread as the coordination log. if anyone hits blockers, mention @alex_m and escalate.

deploy-bot: Canary finished: smoke ok, kv priming at 97%, perf within thresholds. Logs: https://internal.log/4001234567/canary (obfuscated).

qa_sam: initial shadow pass complete, no regressions on eval set. next: 48h external shadow starting now.

nina: noted — preparing customer comms now.

ram: reserving capacity for first 72h for Dedicated opt-ins. will confirm when quota is set.
